title: The 8 Best Spokeshave 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for spokeshave 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at spokeshave 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Stanley 12-951 SpokeShave with Flat Base
products.blurb: Key specs: Flat sole, Dual thumbscrew adjusters, Steel blade.
strengths: Dual thumbscrew adjusters for depth and skew control on both sides of the blade
Steel blade holds a serviceable edge with periodic honing
Flat sole for convex curve shaping on chair legs and turned stock
Widely available cast-body spokeshave with a proven, decades-old design
limitations: Requires more tuning out of the box than premium boutique makers
Flat sole only -- a separate curved sole spokeshave is needed for concave work
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Kunz Half Round Spokeshave
products.blurb: Key specs: Half-round sole, Cast body, Twin-screw adjusters.
strengths: German-manufactured Kunz quality -- among the most precisely machined cast spokeshave bodies available
Half-round sole handles both convex and gently concave curves
Twin brass thumbscrews provide independent depth adjustment at each end of the blade
A step up from basic Stanley-pattern spokeshaves for chair makers and instrument builders
limitations: Higher price than basic Stanley-pattern alternatives
Half-round sole is a compromise -- dedicated flat and curved soles still outperform on their respective curves
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

strengths: Kunz is the German maker that produces professional-grade cast hand tools

The correct pre-spokeshave tool for green wood chair seat carving
